analysis:
Examined three changed files: scripts/provider_release_cache/identity.py (head lines 15-29), the new test scripts/test-provider-cluster-runtime-models.py, and the modified scripts/test-provider-release-pipeline.py. All are build and test tooling. None touches the provider runtime, the coordinator-provider WebSocket, key custody, attestation, App Attest authorization or the prefix cache.

identity.py: it adds scripts/build-cluster-helpers.sh and libs/darkbloom-cluster-worker/build-native-worker.sh to RECIPE_PATHS. Both files are now hashed into the compatibility key, so edits to the cluster helper build recipe invalidate the Swift cache. This tightens cache-key integrity. file_hash is called only for paths that exist, and missing ones are recorded as 'absent'. BUILD_ENV remains an allowlist, so no credentials enter the hash.

The new models test is a unit test against a local 127.0.0.1 server. It asserts the fetcher's protections: redirects refused, body size capped, config.json size and sha256 checked against the manifest, input_modalities validated, exact-match manifests required, and no weight files fetched. It makes no network calls and handles no secrets.

The pipeline test asserts these workflow properties: qualification shards carry no secrets, and a gate job audits shard counts before signing. The cluster-runtime facts step runs after signing with the secret-derived GITHUB_ENV values unset and the signing keychain deleted, and it verifies no signing identity remains. The app CLI runs under env -i. The send switch is gated on the per-environment vars and on publish. These are test assertions only. The workflow, action and script bodies (release-provider.yml, action.yml, provider-cluster-runtime-facts.sh, provider-cluster-runtime-models.py) were not supplied. The real security properties of the facts step (secret removal ordering, empty environment, continue-on-error semantics when the block is sent) depend on those files and need review in the pass covering them. In particular, whether the facts being sent into the signed publication are bound or validated downstream is outside this batch.

No regression identified in the supplied units.
